---
title: "Paper out in Scientific Reports"
date: 2025-11-01
description: "Experimental diagenesis shows that biosignatures in filamentous sulfur mats can survive hydrothermal conditions."
categories: [paper, sulfur]
---

Our study *Experimental diagenesis reveals preservation of biosignatures in filamentous sulfur
mats under hydrothermal conditions* is now published in **Scientific Reports** (15, 38114).

We grew filamentous sulfur mats in the lab and exposed them to hydrothermal conditions to test
which morphological and chemical biosignatures persist. See the
[Publications page](../../publications.qmd) for the full reference.
